result.description: AI-powered scientific research search engine (consensus.app) that finds, summarizes and cites peer-reviewed papers, with a Consensus Meter.
result.auth_detail: REST API: org-scoped API key sent as Authorization: Bearer. OAuth 2.1 (Auth Code + PKCE, dynamic client registration) applies only to the MCP server, not the REST API, so oauth2 is dropped from REST auth methods.
result.access_detail: REST API keys are issued from the organization subscription page; quotas scoped to org subscription (Teams/Enterprise tiers, contact sales for Enterprise). No evidence of a free self-serve REST key. Free tier exists only for the MCP server. Exact REST gating not confirmed because docs.consensus.app is behind Cloudflare challenge.
result.api_notes: Versioned JSON REST endpoints for search, paper detail, synthesis and Consensus Meter. Read-only research surface. Full reference at docs.consensus.app could not be fetched (Cloudflare challenge).
result.blocker: REST API key appears tied to an organization subscription (paid/enterprise), not free self-serve. OAuth exists only via the MCP server, so an OAuth-based toolkit would have to go through MCP (free tier available, dynamic client registration). Narrow read-only surface.

evidence.quote: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request
Issued from the organization subscription page at https://consensus.app/subscription/api/
Pricing and request quotas are scoped to organization subscriptions; see the docs for the current schema and limits.
It exposes search, paper detail, synthesis, and the Consensus Meter as stable, versioned JSON endpoints with bearer-token authentication.
OAuth-based authentication, dynamic client registration, streaming-friendly.
Consensus is an AI-powered search engine for scientific research that helps users find, synthesize, and cite peer-reviewed papers.
